name: Grid
descriptor: Two fields crossed: one down the side, one across the top, a count in each cell, and totals on both edges.
pros: two dimensions at once, which no other view offers
both edges are totalled, so the margins are free
an empty cell is visible, and that is usually the finding
it prints well, because a matrix is a table
cons: two dimensions only, and both must be short lists
more than about eight columns needs a wide screen
no third dimension, no drill-down from a cell
best_for: a quick read of where things cluster across two attributes
avoid_if: you need sums in the cells, or a third dimension
